name: MacKreel's Moonshine
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Had quite a bit of the ol' Moonshine last night!  Longbraid would have my head if he knew that I passed out during my watch.

The noggin hurts something fierce.  Felt as though a whole brigade of siege engines passed overhead, all that rumbling.

Oh my, look at the time! I promised Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore that I'd repay my debt to him by sending some Moonshine.

But there are just 15 minutes left before I'm overdue!  Take him this batch, would you please?  And hurry!
narrative.objectives: Take MacKreel's Moonshine to Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, nothing like Foggy MacKreel's Moonshine to warm you up on a brisk day! And here I was thinking the little bugger was going to be overdue on his bills again. Thank you, friend! Many thanks indeed!
